name: Kounotori 3 gouki
about: Kounotori 3 gouki (2012-038A), a crewed vehicle (HTV), launched 2012 Jul 21. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2012 Jul 23), held fixed
docked to A06499; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
